## Hardware
Say “analysis”. The robot stops animating and goes into analysis mode.

- [ ] It works
- [ ] It doesn’t work, comment:

Say “test brows” or “test motors”. The robot will cycle through all the servos for the eyebrows. It then asks to continue to test eyelids, eyes, cheeks, lips. Go through all the tests and make sure the facial features work as expected.

- [ ] It works
- [ ] It doesn’t work, comment:

Say “test vision”. The robot will say how many faces and hands it sees. Hold your hand in front of the robot and say “test vision” again. The robot should now see your hand. Face the robot closely, and say “test vision” again. The robot should now see your face.

- [ ] It works
- [ ] It doesn’t work, comment:

Say “what is your version number”. The robot will read out the software and hardware version numbers. Make sure these are correct (the latest).

- [ ] It works
- [ ] It doesn’t work, comment:

Say “what is your serial number”. The robot will read out the robot serial number and model type. Make sure these are correct.

- [ ] It works
- [ ] It doesn’t work, comment:

Say “resume”. The robot will go back to normal mode and animate again.

- [ ] It works
- [ ] It doesn’t work, comment:
